verses.original: פְּתַ֥ח לְבָנ֖וֹן דְּלָתֶ֑יךָ וְתֹאכַ֥ל אֵ֖שׁ בַּאֲרָזֶֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: Open your doors O Lebanon that the fire may consume your cedars
verses.literalPt: ABRE, ó Líbano, as tuas portas para que o fogo consuma os teus cedros.

verses.original: הֵילֵ֤ל בְּרוֹשׁ֙ כִּֽי־ נָ֣פַל אֶ֔רֶז אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַדִּרִ֖ים שֻׁדָּ֑דוּ הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ אַלּוֹנֵ֣י בָשָׁ֔ן כִּ֥י יָרַ֖ד יַ֥עַר הַבָּצוּר׃
verses.transliteration: hê·lêl bə·rō·wōš kî- nā·p̄al ’e·rez ’ă·šer ’ad·di·rîm šud·dā·ḏū hê·lî·lū ’al·lō·w·nê ḇā·šān kî yā·raḏ ya·‘ar hab·bå̄·ṣūr
verses.literal: Wail O cypress for the cedar has fallen the majestic trees are ruined Wail O oaks of Bashan for the dense forest has been cut down
verses.literalPt: Geme, ó cipreste, porque o cedro caiu, porque os mais poderosos são destruídos; gemei, ó carvalhos de Basã, porque o bosque forte é derrubado.

verses.original: ק֚וֹל יִֽלְלַ֣ת הָרֹעִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה אַדַּרְתָּ֑ם ק֚וֹל שַׁאֲגַ֣ת כְּפִירִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד גְּא֥וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: qō·wl yil·laṯ hā·rō·‘îm kî šud·də·ḏāh ’ad·dar·tām qō·wl ša·’ă·ḡaṯ kə·p̄î·rîm kî šud·daḏ gə·’ō·wn hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Listen to the wailing of the shepherds for their glory . . . is in ruins Listen to the roaring of the young lions for the thickets of the Jordan are destroyed
verses.literalPt: Voz de uivo dos pastores! porque a sua glória é destruída; voz de bramido dos filhos de leões, porque foi destruída a soberba do Jordão.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י רְעֵ֖ה אֶת־ צֹ֥אן הַהֲרֵגָֽה׃
verses.literal: This is what the LORD my God says Pasture the flock marked for slaughter
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR meu Deus: Apascenta as ovelhas da matança,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר קֹנֵיהֶ֤ן יַֽהֲרְגֻן֙ וְלֹ֣א יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ וּמֹכְרֵיהֶ֣ן יֹאמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֖ה וַאעְשִׁ֑ר וְרֹ֣עֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יַחְמ֖וֹל עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer qō·nê·hen ya·hăr·ḡun wə·lō ye’·šā·mū ū·mō·ḵə·rê·hen yō·mar bā·rūḵ Yah·weh wa‘·šir wə·rō·‘ê·hem lō yaḥ·mō·wl ‘ă·lê·hen
verses.literal: whose buyers slaughter them without remorse Those who sell them say Blessed be the LORD for I am rich Even their own shepherds have no compassion on them
verses.literalPt: Cujos possuidores as matam, e não se têm por culpados; e cujos vendedores dizem: Louvado seja o SENHOR, porque tenho enriquecido; e os seus pastores não têm piedade delas.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א אֶחְמ֥וֹל ע֛וֹד עַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַמְצִ֣יא אֶת־ הָאָדָ֗ם אִ֤ישׁ בְּיַד־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ וּבְיַ֣ד מַלְכּ֔וֹ וְכִתְּתוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א אַצִּ֖יל מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ’eḥ·mō·wl ‘ō·wḏ ‘al- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mam·ṣî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām ’îš bə·yaḏ- rê·‘ê·hū ū·ḇə·yaḏ mal·kōw wə·ḵit·tə·ṯū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō ’aṣ·ṣîl mî·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: For I will no longer have compassion on the people of the land declares the LORD but behold I will cause each man to fall into the hands of his neighbor and his king who will devastate the land and I will not deliver it from their hands
verses.literalPt: Certamente não terei mais piedade dos moradores desta terra, diz o SENHOR; mas, eis que entregarei os homens cada um na mão do seu próximo e na mão do seu rei; eles ferirão a terra, e eu não os livrarei da sua mão.

verses.original: וָֽאֶרְעֶה֙ אֶת־ צֹ֣אן הַֽהֲרֵגָ֔ה לָכֵ֖ן עֲנִיֵּ֣י הַצֹּ֑אן וָאֶקַּֽח־ לִ֞י שְׁנֵ֣י מַקְל֗וֹת לְאַחַ֞ד קָרָ֤אתִי נֹ֙עַם֙ וּלְאַחַד֙ קָרָ֣אתִי חֹֽבְלִ֔ים וָאֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶת־ הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·‘eh ’eṯ- ṣōn ha·hă·rê·ḡāh lā·ḵên ‘ă·nî·yê haṣ·ṣōn wā·’eq·qaḥ- lî šə·nê maq·lō·wṯ lə·’a·ḥaḏ qā·rā·ṯî nō·‘am ū·lə·’a·ḥaḏ qā·rā·ṯî ḥō·ḇə·lîm wā·’er·‘eh ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter especially the afflicted of the flock Then I took for myself two staffs calling one Favor and the other . . . Union and I pastured the flock
verses.literalPt: Eu, pois, apascentei as ovelhas da matança, as pobres ovelhas do rebanho. Tomei para mim duas varas: a uma chamei Graça, e à outra chamei União; e apascentei as ovelhas.

verses.original: וָאַכְחִ֛ד אֶת־ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָרֹעִ֖ים בְּיֶ֣רַח אֶחָ֑ד וַתִּקְצַ֤ר נַפְשִׁי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְגַם־ נַפְשָׁ֖ם בָּחֲלָ֥ה בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’aḵ·ḥiḏ ’eṯ- šə·lō·šeṯ hā·rō·‘îm bə·ye·raḥ ’e·ḥāḏ wat·tiq·ṣar nap̄·šî bā·hem wə·ḡam- nap̄·šām bā·ḥă·lāh ḇî
verses.literal: And in one month I dismissed three shepherds My soul grew impatient with the flock and their souls also detested me
verses.literalPt: E destruí os três pastores num mês; porque a minha alma se impacientou deles, e também a alma deles se enfastiou de mim.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר לֹ֥א אֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם הַמֵּתָ֣ה תָמ֗וּת וְהַנִּכְחֶ֙דֶת֙ תִּכָּחֵ֔ד וְהַ֨נִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת תֹּאכַ֕לְנָה אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־ בְּשַׂ֥ר רְעוּתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar lō ’er·‘eh ’eṯ·ḵem ham·mê·ṯāh ṯā·mūṯ wə·han·niḵ·ḥe·ḏeṯ tik·kā·ḥêḏ wə·han·niš·’ā·rō·wṯ tō·ḵal·nāh ’iš·šāh ’eṯ- bə·śar rə·‘ū·ṯāh
verses.literal: Then I said I will no longer shepherd you Let the dying die and the perishing perish and let those who remain devour one another’s flesh
verses.literalPt: E eu disse: Não vos apascentarei mais; o que morrer, morra; e o que for destruído, seja destruído; e as que restarem comam cada uma a carne da outra.

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֤ח אֶת־ מַקְלִי֙ אֶת־ נֹ֔עַם וָאֶגְדַּ֖ע אֹת֑וֹ לְהָפֵיר֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- maq·lî ’eṯ- nō·‘am wā·’eḡ·da‘ ’ō·ṯōw lə·hā·p̄êr ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’ă·šer kā·rat·tî ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: Next I took my staff called Favor and cut it in two revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations
verses.literalPt: E tomei a minha vara Graça, e a quebrei, para desfazer a minha aliança, que tinha estabelecido com todos estes povos.

verses.original: וַתֻּפַ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֵּדְע֨וּ כֵ֜ן עֲנִיֵּ֤י הַצֹּאן֙ הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י כִּ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tu·p̄ar bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yê·ḏə·‘ū ḵên ‘ă·nî·yê haṣ·ṣōn haš·šō·mə·rîm ’ō·ṯî kî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hū
verses.literal: It was revoked on that day and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew that it was the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E foi desfeito naquele dia; e assim conheceram os pobres do rebanho, que me respeitavam, que isto era palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אִם־ ט֧וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֛ם הָב֥וּ שְׂכָרִ֖י וְאִם־ לֹ֣א׀ חֲדָ֑לוּ וַיִּשְׁקְל֥וּ אֶת־ שְׂכָרִ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·hem ’im- ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem hā·ḇū śə·ḵā·rî wə·’im- lō ḥă·ḏā·lū way·yiš·qə·lū ’eṯ- śə·ḵā·rî šə·lō·šîm kā·sep̄
verses.literal: Then I told them If it seems right to you give me my wages but if not keep them So they weighed out my wages thirty pieces of silver
verses.literalPt: Porque eu lhes disse: Se parece bem aos vossos olhos, dai-me o meu salário e, se não, deixai-o. E pesaram o meu salário, trinta moedas de prata.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַשְׁלִיכֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר אֶ֣דֶר הַיְקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָקַ֖רְתִּי מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶקְחָה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים הַכֶּ֔סֶף וָאַשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הַיּוֹצֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay haš·lî·ḵê·hū ’el- hay·yō·w·ṣêr ’e·ḏer hay·qār ’ă·šer yā·qar·tî mê·‘ă·lê·hem wā·’eq·ḥāh šə·lō·šîm hak·ke·sep̄ wā·’aš·lîḵ ’ō·ṯōw bêṯ Yah·weh ’el- hay·yō·w·ṣêr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me Throw it to the potter this magnificent price at which they valued me . . . So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR, pois, disse-me: Arroja isso ao oleiro, esse belo preço em que fui avaliado por eles. E tomei as trinta moedas de prata, e as arrojei ao oleiro, na casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וָֽאֶגְדַּע֙ אֶת־ מַקְלִ֣י הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖ת הַחֹֽבְלִ֑ים לְהָפֵר֙ אֶת־ הָֽאַחֲוָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’eḡ·da‘ ’eṯ- maq·lî haš·šê·nî ’êṯ ha·ḥō·ḇə·lîm lə·hā·p̄êr ’eṯ- hā·’a·ḥă·wāh bên yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇên yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then I cut in two my second staff called Union breaking the brotherhood between Judah . . . and Israel
verses.literalPt: Então quebrei a minha segunda vara União, para romper a irmandade entre Judá e Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד קַח־ לְךָ֔ כְּלִ֖י רֹעֶ֥ה אֱוִלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāy ‘ō·wḏ qaḥ- lə·ḵā kə·lî rō·‘eh ’ĕ·wi·lî
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me Take up once more the equipment of a foolish shepherd
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR disse-me: Toma ainda para ti o instrumento de um pastor insensato.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּֽה־ אָנֹכִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים רֹעֶ֜ה בָּאָ֗רֶץ הַנִּכְחָד֤וֹת לֹֽא־ יִפְקֹד֙ הַנַּ֣עַר לֹֽא־ יְבַקֵּ֔שׁ וְהַנִּשְׁבֶּ֖רֶת לֹ֣א יְרַפֵּ֑א הַנִּצָּבָה֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכֵּ֔ל וּבְשַׂ֤ר הַבְּרִיאָה֙ יֹאכַ֔ל וּפַרְסֵיהֶ֖ן יְפָרֵֽק׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh- ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·qîm rō·‘eh bā·’ā·reṣ han·niḵ·ḥā·ḏō·wṯ lō- yip̄·qōḏ han·na·‘ar lō- yə·ḇaq·qêš wə·han·niš·be·reṯ lō yə·rap·pê han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇāh lō yə·ḵal·kêl ū·ḇə·śar hab·bə·rî·’āh yō·ḵal ū·p̄ar·sê·hen yə·p̄ā·rêq
verses.literal: For behold I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will neither care for the lost nor seek the young nor heal the broken nor sustain the healthy . . . but he will devour the flesh of the choice sheep and tear off their hooves
verses.literalPt: Porque, eis que suscitarei um pastor na terra, que não cuidará das que estão perecendo, não buscará a pequena, e não curará a ferida, nem apascentará a sã; mas comerá a carne da gorda, e lhe despedaçará as unhas.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֤י הָֽאֱלִיל֙ עֹזְבִ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן חֶ֥רֶב עַל־ זְרוֹע֖וֹ וְעַל־ עֵ֣ין יְמִינ֑וֹ זְרֹעוֹ֙ יָב֣וֹשׁ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְעֵ֥ין יְמִינ֖וֹ כָּהֹ֥ה תִכְהֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w rō·‘î hā·’ĕ·lîl ‘ō·zə·ḇî haṣ·ṣōn ḥe·reḇ ‘al- zə·rō·w·‘ōw wə·‘al- ‘ên yə·mî·nōw zə·rō·‘ōw yā·ḇō·wōš tî·ḇāš wə·‘ên yə·mî·nōw kā·hōh ṯiḵ·heh
verses.literal: Woe to the worthless shepherd who deserts the flock May a sword . . . strike his arm . . . and his right eye May his arm be completely withered . . . and his right eye utterly blinded . . .
verses.literalPt: Ai do pastor inútil, que abandona o rebanho! A espada cairá sobre o seu braço e sobre o seu olho direito; e o seu braço completamente se secará, e o seu olho direito completamente se escurecerá.
